skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of e-commerce to analyze and evaluate business activities, propose improvements and innovations in business and management activities.
Conduct market research, analyze data, and provide actionable insights for business decisions.
Design and execute independent research projects, including data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Identify and solve problems in e-commerce business operations.
Write comprehensive reports and present findings effectively.
Analyze and evaluate business activities, providing recommendations for improvement.
Engage in continuous learning and professional development.
Effectively communicate research findings and business insights.
Manage research projects, including planning, execution, and reporting.
Collaborate with peers and stakeholders in research and business activities.
